PRM/KA/RERA/1254/464/PR/260224/006652.project_description: The neuro-developmental disability is making communication a challenge for the individual and hence due to this basic requirements for leading life like, health, safety and engagements are severely impaired in majority of the cases. Akshadhaa Assisted Living is designed to involve the various stakeholders for the disabled person to enable this living program. Parents are the closest stakeholders who understand the needs of the disabled person the most. As per prevailing international practices the critical programs like Safety, Health, Education and Engagement, Food and nutrition, etc… at Akshadhaa Assisted Living are planned to involve the parents. In order to facilitate the programs hence there is a space for hosting the parents in the same campus in order that they can work in a concerted manner to make their children increasingly independent each passing day with support from the teachers, professionals and staff who will work under the guidance of Akshadhaa Foundation programs. Apart from the living quarters of the disabled people and their parents, we have planned to create a vibrant space where the education, engagement, health and safety related programs would be hosted and carried out. Also planned are protocol based open spaces where people with neuro-developmental and their ageing families needs can be met in a constructive manner. Apart from the in-house population, Akshadhaa Assisted Living aims to address the healthcare and the disability needs of the people living in the vicinity of the project being socially integrated and responsible.
